FieldId mapping переживает label rename; removal блокирует publish; dry-run без effects и с simulation label.
scopeDelta.distinctNegativeControl: Map fields by label or allow owner-wide query under workflow user assumptions.
scopeDelta.exclusion: No reimplementation of the entire linked epic or a second editor/catalog/task store/automation builder.

issues.title: [ROX Suite Extension][LSX-WP-042] Revision-pinned artifact/approval nodes и safe retry receipts

scopeDelta.boundedGoal: Document artifact/approval step pins immutable revision+payload digest; changed Doc invalidates request, restart retains classified step receipts.
concreteAcceptance: Approval/artifact привязаны к immutable Doc revision и exact digest.
Current ACL на resume/replay; stable logical step key, explicit unknown external result/partial cancellation; timeout не approve.
scopeDelta.distinctNegativeControl: Approve changed revision under old digest or retry logical step with new key.
scopeDelta.exclusion: No reimplementation of the entire linked epic or a second editor/catalog/task store/automation builder.

issues.title: [ROX Suite Extension][LSX-WP-043] Weekly Report workflow recipe с scoped draft/owner review

scopeDelta.boundedGoal: Schedule query permitted Tasks/Meetings produces draft Doc with missing-data report, owner checkpoint and optional reviewed artifact.
concreteAcceptance: Real Query→agent draft→Doc→owner review даёт один Report draft на occurrence.
Source coverage/missing data честны; hidden source не попадает в context/report, timeout ничего не отправляет.
scopeDelta.distinctNegativeControl: Use unrestricted agent context or publish automatically on timeout.
scopeDelta.exclusion: No reimplementation of the entire linked epic or a second editor/catalog/task store/automation builder.

issues.title: [ROX Suite Extension][LSX-WP-044] Form submission→native Task/Base recipe без второй task DB

scopeDelta.boundedGoal: Accepted Forms submission uses typed mapped fields to create one native Task+source link; Base displays same ref.
concreteAcceptance: Accepted Form event создаёт одну native Task/source link; Base показывает тот же Task ref.
Typed native validators/least scope соблюдены; event replay даёт одну intended assignment notification.
scopeDelta.distinctNegativeControl: Dedup by responseID alone or create Task in Base-local rows.
scopeDelta.exclusion: No reimplementation of the entire linked epic or a second editor/catalog/task store/automation builder.

issues.title: [ROX Suite Extension][LSX-WP-045] Explicit CustomRecord page payload для нового типа данных

scopeDelta.boundedGoal: Create «Новый тип записей» сохраняет typed record в canonical page+contentKind=record; Task source never converted automatically.
concreteAcceptance: Новый тип создаётся явно как page+contentKind=record и имеет один typed payload owner.
Task source остаётся native projection; schema/row CAS и history/future-version retention сохраняются.
scopeDelta.distinctNegativeControl: Auto-copy Tasks to CustomRecord or introduce unversioned new kind.
scopeDelta.exclusion: No reimplementation of the entire linked epic or a second editor/catalog/task store/automation builder.

issues.title: [ROX Suite Extension][LSX-WP-046] Versioned template gallery с inert actions и bounded creation

scopeDelta.boundedGoal: Template preview declares capabilities/schema/actions/assets; confirm creates one Doc and explicit linked entities through bounded workflow.
concreteAcceptance: Template preview полностью inert и показывает hash/version/capabilities/audience/effects.
Повторный confirm возвращает те же Doc/child receipts; partial failures и private asset/source grants явны.
scopeDelta.distinctNegativeControl: Run imported workflow during template preview or retry child step with new origin.
scopeDelta.exclusion: No reimplementation of the entire linked epic or a second editor/catalog/task store/automation builder.
